title: Result-Review Visits after Imaging and Rehabilitation Work-Up (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Primary Care Provider Assignment — result-review visits on a single specialist referral.**

**Clause.** Result-review visits are added to a single specialist referral's visits for completed work-up, before the single-referral visit ceiling is applied. The work-up is read from the member's **Prior Authorization** records: a member who holds an approved **Advanced Imaging Authorization** and also an approved **Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization** receives the two-visit review allowance (**2** visits); a member who holds exactly one of the two receives the one-visit review allowance (**1** visit); a member who holds neither receives no review visit.

Only authorizations in approved status count. An Advanced Imaging Authorization that is submitted, pended for information, denied, expired, voided or withdrawn is not an approved one.

**Truth table**

| Approved Advanced Imaging Authorization | Approved Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | Result-review visits |
|---|---|---|
| Held | Held | 2 |
| Held | Not held | 1 |
| Not held | Held | 1 |
| Not held | Not held | 0 |

**Cases (hypothetical members)**

- An approved Advanced Imaging Authorization for an MRI and an approved Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization for physical therapy: 2 review visits.
- An approved Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization and an Advanced Imaging Authorization still submitted: 1 review visit.
- An approved Durable Medical Equipment Authorization only: neither of the two classes is held, no review visit.
